First public version. mieruka shows which Markdown files Claude Code and Codex load in a project, checks them for problems, and tracks edits that nobody has reviewed yet.

In this release:

- A local web UI (`mieruka` in a project folder) with a reader, an editor with live preview, and a panel listing what each agent loads at session start, what it loads later and what it skips.
- Checks for paths that no longer exist, broken or too-deep `@imports`, an `AGENTS.md` that Claude Code ignores, files Codex cuts at 32 KiB, files loaded twice and an oversized `CLAUDE.md`.
- Review of changes made outside mieruka to instruction files and Claude's project memory, with Accept, Revert and undo.
- `mieruka check` for CI, with text, GitHub annotation and JSON output, and `mieruka context` for the terminal.

## Download

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows x64 | `mieruka-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip` |
| macOS, Apple Silicon | `mieruka-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz` |
| macOS, Intel | `mieruka-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz` |
| Linux x64 | `mieruka-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz` |

Each archive holds one binary and the license. `SHA256SUMS` lists the checksums.

The binaries are not signed yet. On macOS, run `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine mieruka` once after unpacking; on Windows, SmartScreen may ask you to confirm the first start.

This is an early version: token counts are estimates, and only Claude Code and Codex are supported so far. Bug reports and differences from what your agent actually loads are welcome in the issues.
